method.unit: One set of three runs per task/model/variant; mean of its three saved pairwise cosine scores (stored mean retained), plus separately one saved LLM Boolean.
method.semantic_scale: Cosine similarity [-1,1], not a probability or percentage of meaning retained.
method.functional_scale: Proportion of three-output sets marked functionally identical by the original GPT-5.4-pro judge. This is distinct from the all-pairs cosine > 0.85 diagnostic and from Astra quality ratings.
method.contrasts: Paired by task/model; PEIL minus naive, and supplementary labelled minus unlabelled. Functional differences on proportion scale; multiply by100 for percentage points.
method.weighting: Equal fixed models within task, then equal tasks. Whole-task resampling keeps variants/models together.
method.uncertainty: Retrospective descriptive task-composition sensitivity: 10,000 percentile whole-task bootstrap draws, seed20261019; leave-one-task-out range. No population inference, p-values, equivalence claim, or new rubric. Task/model-task results only finite observed ranges.
method.cohorts: Matched216 is run1 subset and cannot provide separate three-run reproducibility. Corrective162 results assessed independently for existing coverage; never inferred from quality ties.
method.limits: Three runs and one unblinded functional judgment per cell; no judge uncertainty, new calibration, vectors, or equivalence margin.
